For EMBA 27 internal use only. This is a personal, non-commercial study guide made by a member of the Boise State University Executive MBA cohort 27 for classmates. It is not a Boise State University publication and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Boise State University, its faculty, or its guest speakers. Please do not share it outside the cohort.

Copyright. Course materials, slides, cases, and readings belong to their authors, faculty, and publishers. This guide does not reproduce them: it contains short summaries in the author's own words, citations, and links to sources that are publicly available, for personal study and classroom discussion. Diagrams are simplified redrawings for study. Names of faculty and guest speakers are used only to say who taught each session. Book summaries marked "general summary" reflect each book's widely published main ideas, not class materials. To request a correction or removal of any item, contact the cohort member who shared this page, and it will be removed promptly.
